meta.title: Heart house dance, 2-bar loop
meta.coordinates: Block units on the 24x24 canvas, origin at the top-left corner, x right, y down. Every point is the top-left corner of a 1x1 block. Pixel version values are whole cells; smooth version values are multiples of 1/16 block (1 px at 16 px per block).
meta.sides: left/right are screen-left and screen-right, matching the character sheet.
meta.body: body_origin is where cell (0,0) of the 16x16 character grid sits on the canvas; add each body_cells entry to it to place the body. body_offset is the same thing relative to rest (rest origin = [5, 7]). The body shape never changes.
meta.limbs: Each limb is 3 blocks, listed from the shoulder/hip end to the hand/foot. Blocks may share a cell (tucked limb) or leave a gap (flick or stretch).
meta.draw_order: Body and legs white. Arms white, except any arm pixel that lands on the body is drawn black. In the pixel version the *_over_body flags mark those blocks.

anchors.note: Limb blocks are listed from the shoulder/hip end to the hand/foot. Offsets are (dx, dy) in blocks from the anchor cell, x right, y down. The anchor is the empty cell directly above the limb's top block in the rest pose.
